name: Armor of Fiery Retribution
body:
Aura: moderate abjuration; CL 9th; Slot: chest; Price: +8,000 gp; Weight: as masterwork armor of the appropriate type.

DESCRIPTION

Whenever the wearer of this armor suffers a critical hit from a metal melee weapon (or metal creature such as an iron golem), it instantly casts heat metal on the attacker at caster level 9 (Will DC 18 negates).

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Magic Arms and Armor; Spells heat metal; Cost: +4,000 gp.
